$comment: Canonical constants. Every value has a source and as_of date. The Methodology page and the TS calc mirror are generated from this file. status: verified (checked against the primary source), estimate (market data, user-editable), assumption (stated as such in the UI).

pm_surya_ghar_subsidy.label: PM Surya Ghar central subsidy
pm_surya_ghar_subsidy.source: Cabinet approves PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PIB, 29 Feb 2024): CFA of 60% of system cost up to 2 kW and 40% of additional cost from 2 to 3 kW, capped at 3 kW. ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, ₹78,000 for 3 kW or more.

pm_surya_ghar_ghs_subsidy.label: PM Surya Ghar subsidy for housing societies (common facilities)
pm_surya_ghar_ghs_subsidy.source: MNRE Office Memorandum No. 318/17/2024-Grid Connected Rooftop (7 June 2024), Operational Guidelines, CFA to Residential Consumers, §5(e) and §5(h): GHS/RWA common facilities including EV charging, ₹18,000/kWp (₹19,800 in special category states), up to 500 kWp at 3 kWp per house. The cap includes plants installed by individual residents. The connection must serve common facilities only.

grid_emission_factor.label: Grid emission factor (India, weighted average)
grid_emission_factor.source: CEA CO₂ Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, User Guide v21.0 (Dec 2025): FY 2024-25 weighted average 0.71 tCO₂/MWh (1,234.19 Mt CO₂ / 1,739.06 BU).

roof_area_per_kw.label: Shadow-free roof area per kW
roof_area_per_kw.source: MNRE FAQ, Grid Connected Solar Rooftop System: 'A 1 kW rooftop system generally requires 10 sq. metres of shadow-free area.'

performance_ratio.label: Performance ratio
performance_ratio.source: Typical for Indian rooftop systems (heat, inverter, soiling and wiring losses). Cross-checked against PVGIS with 14% system loss.

shading_factor.label: Shading factor
shading_factor.source: Groundwork assumption: a simple derate applied to the performance ratio. Shown to the user with the shading choice.

panel_degradation.label: Panel output loss per year
panel_degradation.source: Typical crystalline-silicon module warranty curves (about 0.5–0.7% a year).

tariff_escalation_default.label: Electricity price rise per year (default)
tariff_escalation_default.source: Groundwork assumption, adjustable from 0% to 8% on every report.

solar_cost_benchmark.label: Installed cost before subsidy (Maharashtra)
solar_cost_benchmark.source: Midpoints of Maharashtra on-grid price ranges (Bluebird Solar, 2025). The 3 kW point sits within SolarSquare's indicative Pune price of about ₹2.15 lakh (Jul 2026). Linear between points. Editable on every report, because installer quotes vary.

urban_water_benchmark_lpcd.label: Urban water supply benchmark
urban_water_benchmark_lpcd.source: CPHEEO / MoUD Handbook of Service Level Benchmarking: per capita supply of water, benchmark 135 lpcd.

running_toilet_litres_per_day.label: Water a running toilet can waste
running_toilet_litres_per_day.source: US EPA WaterSense, Fix a Leak Week family fact sheet: a constantly running toilet can waste 200 gallons or more every day (200 US gal = 757 L).

dripping_tap_litres_per_year.label: Water a tap dripping once a second wastes
dripping_tap_litres_per_year.source: US EPA WaterSense, Fix a Leak Week: a faucet dripping once per second can waste more than 3,000 gallons per year (3,000 US gal = 11,356 L).

waste_streams.label: Household waste streams
waste_streams.source: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (in force from 1 April 2026): households segregate waste into four streams at source: wet, dry, sanitary and special care.
